nom: La Roche-Posay Effaclar Clarifying Solution Salicylic Acid Toner, 6.7oz

avis.texte: I’ve been using the La Roche-Posay Effaclar Clarifying Solution for a few weeks now, and I can honestly say it has made a huge difference in my skin. I have combination to oily skin with some acne marks and uneven texture, and this toner has helped a lot to smooth, refine, and brighten my complexion. Right after applying it, my skin feels fresh and clean without any tightness or irritation. It removes leftover impurities after cleansing and helps control excess oil throughout the day. I’ve noticed that my pores look smaller and my skin tone is more even. The formula contains salicylic acid and glycolic acid, which gently exfoliate and renew the skin’s surface. I really appreciate that it’s strong enough to work, but still gentle — it doesn’t sting or dry me out like some other exfoliating toners do. It also helps prevent new breakouts while fading old marks over time. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin soft and smooth. I usually apply it with a cotton pad before my serum or moisturizer, and it layers perfectly with the rest of my skincare routine. Overall, this Effaclar Clarifying Solution is one of the best toners I’ve tried. It keeps my skin clear, balanced, and glowing. If you have oily or acne-prone skin and want something that truly works without harshness, I highly recommend it!

I love using it because it always manages to remove extra dirt (shown in the photo) and residue even right after I just washed my face. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Worked wonders for my acne!Worked wonders for my acne!
avis.texte: As a result woman in her late 30’s, acne hit me by surprise but this entire skin care line has done wonders to my skin especially from prior cystic acne damage. The dark spots are gone and my skin looks amazing!

avis.titre: I couldn’t be happier with the resultsI couldn’t be happier with the results
avis.texte: I have combination skin, so oil control is really important for me. I use this toner to help with that, I couldn’t be happier with the results. I use it every day in my morning routine. I start with a cleanser for oily or combination skin, then use the toner toner, and finish with niacinamide and sunscreen. I’ve noticed a big difference in how my skin controls oil. I live in a hot and humid country, so my skin tends to get oily, but this has really helped. My skin looks healthier and has a nice glow. I love it so much I’m about to buy my third bottle! It also lasts a long time, I’ve been using this toner for about four years, and each bottle takes a while to finish. Definitely worth it.

avis.titre: Great solution, lasts long enough to justify the price
avis.texte: This solution works really well to help keep my skin clear and I use it after I cleanse my face. I don’t go a day or night without it as my skin starts to break out if I don’t use it. It keeps my skin from being too oily and keeps the tone even. I bought it to help shrink my pores which it doesn’t quite do, but it does help keep my skin clear so I’ve continued to use it and have been for a couple years now. It usually lasts me around 6 months, which justifies the price for me, and I would recommend this to anyone looking to keep their skin from breaking out (for the most part - I still get hormonal break-outs and I don’t know anything that can help that), and to keep their skin clean and healthy.

I’m 36 and suffer with adult acne due to PMOS (PCOS). I use it every morning and night after washing my facing. Really helps keep my skin calm. Only been using this toner for 2 months, but so far i like what i see! Especially the stubborn chin acne is slowly calming down. Love how my skin feels nice and soft and refreshed.

I've used La Roche-Posay products for a while, way before they went viral. They are a must have and buy. To begin, it's non-comedogenic which translate to non clogging the face pores. This helps to maintain clear healthy skin. For those with sensitive skin like me, it's suitable for all skin type due to it being gentle. Yet, it is effective with toning, removing excess oils and dead skin cells, to name a few. Helps with reducing and preventing acne, blackheads, and whiteheads. It has Antioxidant properties which helps to exfoliate the skin among other things. And, the big kicker of it all is, it contains No Parabens, oils or fragrances. Again, caterering to healthy skin. Definitely a logical investment.
